hypothesis: Replacing quotation copying with immutable passage references reduces mechanical attribution failures without demonstrating entailment or selector quality.
dataset: Four exposed frozen source-use contexts; no new acquisition; cannot be untouched confirmation
matching: Same source bytes, order, task purpose and original facets for each matched pair.
Both formats see identical fixed-width passage segmentation; only ID arm has explicit reference identifiers.
Same prospective observable checks supplied to both arms. Completed pilot outcomes remain unchanged.
Fresh answerers receive one packet only; no prior assessment/order labels.

Assessor delivery replaces both reference forms with mechanically resolved text; unresolved links remain failures with zero evidence credit. Assessor blinding is imperfect because response wording can reveal format.

Both reference forms identify one whole identical passage of at most 600 characters; quote arm copies the whole passage, ID arm selects its identifier. This differs from old pilot short-quote protocol and does not repair or remeasure it.
metrics: Per-arm total claims, mechanically valid/invalid reference counts and rates, missing/unknown/source-mismatch counts.
Per-context facet completeness, unsupported material claims and abstentions from two independent advisory assessors.
No ordinal quality or task-completion claim from reference resolution alone.
decision: Process validity only if every ID answer contains at least one evidence-bearing claim, every ID reference resolves with exact claimed source identity, and no unknown/cross-context/undelivered reference is accepted. Compare error counts/rates and claim counts descriptively against matched quote controls; zero errors alone does not demonstrate reduction. Advisory assessors compare paired answers facet-by-facet and record unsupported claims and losses independently, preserving disagreements. No observed harm can only support bounded noninferiority, not utility improvement. No selector adoption credit regardless of result.
stop: Any input hash/schema/packet isolation failure before invocation.
No output repair, case substitution or rerun on an invalid result.

bounds.model_checkpoint: alias exposed only; immutable checkpoint unknown

validation: Quote must equal one complete delivered passage with the claimed source_id. No normalization or repair.
ID must resolve against this packet catalog and assigned sources; returned passage source_id must equal output source_id.
Schema, 40-claim bound, 600-character passage unit, 60000-byte JSON and 800 answer-word bound are verified before advisory assessment; failures retained.
freeze: Before dispatch record SHA256 of every exact prompt, schema, protocol, registration, builder/validator and isolated packet; private mapping and complete randomized eight-answer dispatch schedule also sealed. All answers sealed before randomized assessor packets are prepared and hash sealed. Randomization is recorded once, never redrawn based on outputs.
